title.narrative: Supporting youths and women civic participation in Uvira diocese

description.narrative: This project includes a range of activities aimed to contribute to increase the civic and electoral participation of young people and women in the democratic process, local governance and ongoing electoral process. It seeks to empower and raise awareness of the targeted youths and women to interact with local authorities and urge them to be more accountable, to apply good governance principles when managing the city and ensure youths and women voice are heard. Through this project, CDJP Uvira plans to prepare youths, marginalized and women to avoid tensions, political manipulations in the ongoing local elections. It also seeks to involve in a credible, responsible and peaceful way the political and traditional authorities and community leaders in managing land and power conflicts in their respective communities. Workshops, trainings, community and media sessions, sociocultural events, dialogs on key local governance issues as well as advocacy initiatives will be done to reach project objectives. Project also plans to carry out mediation initiative through dialogue meetings between the parties to the different conflicts pinned to enhance social cohesion within communities and to work mainly on peace connectors. The project will be implemented by CDJP Uvira staff with support from CAFOD Governance and Peace building Program Officer in close collaboration/coordination with Governance and Peace building PM and other relevant CAFOD’s staff.
